why_best: It visually dramatizes the mounting pressure on a static hero asset without losing the audience's anchor point in a vertical format.
why_bad: Pushing the camera straight into the core card would obscure the incoming systemic pressures entirely and undermine the sense of overwhelming encirclement.
trap: A common mistake is allowing the central hero item to drift or scale during the tightening sequence, which destroys the claustrophobic contrast between the frozen middle and the collapsing perimeter.
